title: khammoon: From a Linguistic Guideline to a Thai Morpheme Segmenter
abstract: arXiv:2611.13012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Thai is written without spaces between words, making segmentation a foundational step in most Thai NLP pipelines. Existing tools primarily reproduce the word-level conventions of corpora such as BEST; however, because the notion of a "word" in Thai lacks a unified linguistic consensus, these conventions struggle with productive compounding, leading to arbitrary boundaries and ambiguity in downstream representations. Instead, we propose operating at the morphological level, focusing on khammoon, the smallest atomic unit that carries meaning. Segmenting at the morphemic level provides an explicit, consistent morphological representation that eliminates compounding ambiguity. Crucially, this representation benefits downstream learning: models trained on morphemes perform on par with or exceed word-level baselines across part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, and sentiment classification, demonstrating that linguistic consistency

translated_title: khammoon：从语言学准则到泰语语素切分器
translated_abstract: 泰语书写时词与词之间没有空格，这使得分词成为大多数泰语自然语言处理（NLP）流程中的基础步骤。现有工具主要复现诸如BEST等语料库的词级切分规范；然而，由于泰语中“词”的概念缺乏统一的语言学共识，这些规范难以应对能产性的复合构词，导致切分边界随意，并在下游表示中引入歧义。因此，我们提出在形态学层面进行切分，聚焦于khammoon，即承载意义的最小原子单位（语素）。在语素层面进行切分能够提供显式且一致的形态表示，从而消除复合构词带来的歧义。至关重要的是，这种表示有利于下游学习：基于语素训练的模型在词性标注、命名实体识别和情感分类任务上的表现与词级基线相当甚至更优，这表明语言学上的一致性……
tldr: 该论文提出基于语言学准则构建的泰语语素切分器khammoon，通过在语素（最小意义单位）层面进行切分消除复合构词歧义，且语素级模型在词性标注、命名实体识别和情感分类等下游任务上表现与词级基线相当甚至更优。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes khammoon, a Thai morpheme segmenter grounded in linguistic guidelines, which segments text at the morpheme level to eliminate compounding ambiguity, with morpheme-trained models matching or exceeding word-level baselines on POS tagging, NER, and sentiment classification.
